fullPassage: The best defence most species of octopus have is to stay hidden as much as possible and do their own hunting at night. So to find one in full view in the shallows in daylight was a surprise for two Australian underwater photographers. Actually, what they saw at first was a flounder. It was only when they looked again that they saw a medium-sized octopus, with all eight of its arms folded and its two eyes staring upwards to create the illusion. An octopus has a big brain, excellent eyesight and the ability to change colour and pattern, and this one was using these assets to turn itself into a completely different creature. Many more of this species have been found since then, and there are now photographs of octopuses that could be said to be transforming into sea snakes. And while they mimic, they hunt — producing the spectacle of, say, a flounder suddenly developing an octopodian arm, sticking it down a hole and grabbing whatever's hiding there.

questions.passage: The best defence most species of octopus have is to stay hidden as much as possible and do their own hunting at night. So to find one in full view in the shallows in daylight was a surprise for two Australian underwater photographers. Actually, what they saw at first was a flounder. It was only when they looked again that they saw a medium-sized octopus, with all eight of its arms folded and its two eyes staring upwards to create the illusion. An octopus has a big brain, excellent eyesight and the ability to change colour and pattern, and this one was using these assets to turn ①<u>itself</u> into a completely different creature. Many more of this species ②<u>have been finding</u> since then, and there are now photographs of octopuses that could be said to be transforming into sea snakes. And while they mimic, they hunt — ③<u>producing</u> the spectacle of, say, a flounder suddenly developing an octopodian arm, sticking it down a hole and ④<u>grabbing</u> whatever's hiding there.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② have been finding → have been found: 문어들이 '발견되는' 대상이므로 현재완료 수동 have been found가 맞다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① itself: 주어(this one)와 목적어가 같아 재귀대명사 itself → 적절

❌ ② have been finding → have been found: 'Many more of this species ___ since then'에서 문어들은 사람들에 의해 '발견되는' 대상이므로 수동형 have been found여야 한다. 능동 진행 have been finding은 '(문어들이) 계속 찾고 있다'가 되어 틀림 ←정답

✅ ③ producing: 앞 절에 이어지는 분사구문 → 적절

✅ ④ grabbing: sticking과 병렬을 이루는 능동 분사 → 적절
det.tip: 발견되는 대상 → 현재완료 수동(have been found)

det.tip: 소유격(their own) + 동명사(hunting) = ~의 사냥

det.korean: turn itself into a completely different creature = 자신을 완전히 다른 생물로 바꾸다.

det.tip: turn + 목적어(itself) + into + 명사구 = ~을 …로 바꾸다
